rag.text:
Test: TC-1597 — Feature area - Task Scheduling - Period mode - Changing period mode on Gantt when mapping is not defined
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-80 Feature area - Task Scheduling - Period modes
Labels: teamscheduling

Steps:
1. Go to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1597 Changing period mode on Gantt when mapping is not defined
   Expected: Gantt module is opened. WBS and timeline is visible. Tasks are loaded:

* TC1597 TC-1597 Changing period mode on Gantt when mapping is not defined
* TC1597-1 Bunkrów
* TC1597-2 Nie ma
* TC1597-3 Ale 
* TC1597-4 Też jest
* TC1597-5 Zajebiście!
2. Add period mode and task mode fields to CV if needed.
   Expected: 
3. Click on Data in menu header.
Go to Period mode and click on Manual.
   Expected: Confirmation window appears with message:

Overwriting confirmation

Are you sure you want to overwrite Period Mode for all tasks?

Two buttons are active:
* Overvwrite
* Cancel
4. Click on Overwrite button.
   Expected: Period modes for all tasks are changes to Manual.
5. Move task to future so it's start date is on 26/Mar/21
   Data: taskSummary: Nie ma
   Expected: Task is correctly moved to new date
6. Move task to past so it's start date is again on 16/Mar/21.
   Data: taskSummary: Nie ma
   Expected: Task is correctly moved to new date
7. Perform re-sync
   Expected: Re-sync is finished with success. All tasks still have manual period mode.
8. Go back to Gantt module and perform re-sync
   Expected: Tasks are still in manual mode
9. Click on issuekey of task
   Data: taskSummary: Zajebiście
   Expected: Jira issue view of TC1597-5 is opened.
10. On Jira issue view of task change task mode to lock.
Go back to Gantt and do re-sync
   Expected: Period mode on Gantt timeline is still manual. New value is visible on WBS only in column for Task mode.
11. Move task to past so its start date is on 1/Mar/21
   Data: taskSummary: Zajebiście
   Expected: Task is correctly moved to new date.
12. Click on Data in menu header.
Go to Period mode and click on Auto top-down.
   Expected: Confirmation window appears with message:

Overwriting confirmation

Are you sure you want to overwrite Period Mode for all tasks?

Two buttons are active:
* Overvwrite
* Cancel
13. Click on Overwrite button.
   Expected: Period modes for all tasks are changes to Auto top-down.
14. Perform re-sync
   Expected: Re-sync is finished with success. All tasks have auto top-down period mode.
Value on WBS for Task mode column is still Lock.
